about.description: TanStack Start gives you type-safe routing, server functions, and modern SSR defaults. Use this as a clean foundation, then layer in your own routes, styling, and add-ons.
about.title: A small starter with room to grow.

features.serverFunctionsDesc: Call server code from your UI without creating API boilerplate.
features.streamingDesc: Ship progressively rendered responses for faster experiences.
features.tailwindDesc: Design quickly with utility-first styling and reusable tokens.
features.typeSafeRoutingDesc: Routes and links stay in sync across every page.

subtitle: This base starter intentionally keeps things light: two routes, clean structure, and the essentials you need to build from scratch.
title: Start simple, ship quickly.
